{
  "decision": "APPLY",
  "workflow_yaml": "---
name: CI

on:
  push:
    branches:
      - master
      - 0.6.x
  pull_request:
    branches:
      - master

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  build:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v6
      - name: Setup
        run:  |
          sudo apt-get install cmake liblzma-dev
      - name: Build
        run:  |
          mkdir build
          cd build
          cmake -DDEBIAN=1 -DMULTI_SEMANTICS=1 -DCMAKE_VERBOSE_MAKEFILE=TRUE ..
          make
      - name: Test
        run:  |
          cd build
          make test
",
  "rationale": "Add concurrency with cancel-in-progress to cancel superseded runs for the same workflow and branch/PR. This reduces duplicate work when multiple pushes occur in quick succession, as supported by pattern P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE which reports VM time reduction (free: 1.9%, paid: 4.1%). The change preserves all build and test steps and does not affect required checks (none verified).",
  "evidence_ids": ["pattern:P-LIT-CANCEL-STALE"]
}
